title: FORGET LinkedIn. This Is Where People Actually Get Hired
description:
These are the 10 hidden job boards for finding remote work. 

Everyone’s obsessed with LinkedIn. I’m not.
Because after applying to thousands and thousands of jobs, I realized something:
The best job boards are the ones nobody talks about.

In this video, I’ll show you 10 hidden job boards (Slack groups, niche sites, weird forums) where people are actually getting hired

You wont hear people talking about these on youtube and they won’t show up on Google. But they should.
